subtitle: Spain and France sit atop the 2026 World Cup market as the two European sides with the strongest recent form and squad depth, each unbeaten in extended runs since Euro 2024 and boasting attacking options led by talents such as Lamine Yamal for Spain and Kylian Mbappé plus Ousmane Dembélé for France. England follows closely behind on the back of a perfect World Cup qualifying record and consistent results in major tournaments, while Brazil and Argentina maintain realistic chances through established star power and historical pedigree. The narrow spread among the top six reflects balanced squad quality across multiple contenders, minimal disruptive injuries reported in official lineups, and the absence of any single dominant team entering the expanded 48-nation field.
